entries.title: Norland
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC Early Access build

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC Early Access presentation.

primary.why: Norland is documented as a Windows PC Steam Early Access medieval colony sim. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so the Windows PC build is the only sourced route. Because it remains Early Access, this is a provisional archive recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam Early Access build if the archive accepts an in-development version; otherwise wait for 1.0 and revalidate before a definitive full run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Early Access game: revisit at 1.0 before treating this as a final definitive route.
